purpose: Explicit prerequisites for the source-bound Mac QA library; not a standalone portable module.

dependencies.retention: Exact bytes remain in the Mac private source record; includes an unrelated raw client-config hash and must not be exported unredacted.
Exact Mac source and an unchanged copy in qualification-r2/qa; code has no import-time I/O and imports the first dependency.

staging: qualification-r2 runner reads each exact public-code path with O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW, verifies complete bytes, identity and source SHA, stages identical bytes in its new private QA root, and imports from that explicit directory.
publicRedactionRule: A sanitized code excerpt is review-only until separately source-bound and qualified; it must not be substituted under an original hash.
